tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Scan a domain for AI discoverability: which AI crawlers robots.txt blocks or allows (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot...), llms.txt presence, sitemap, schema.org data, meta and Content Signals. Fetches only /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml and the homepage over HTTPS.

tools.name: crawler_policy_guide
tools.description: Reference table of AI crawlers (owner, purpose, whether they drive AI visibility or training) with rules of thumb for allowing or blocking each.

tools.name: robots_txt_for_ai
tools.description: Generate robots.txt rules for a chosen AI policy (max visibility, search-only, block training, block all AI), optionally with Content-Signal lines and a sitemap reference.

tools.name: llms_txt_draft
tools.description: Draft a starter llms.txt from your business name, one-line description, key pages and contact so AI agents get a curated summary of your site.

tools.name: schema_jsonld_sample
tools.description: Generate a schema.org JSON-LD snippet (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product or FAQ) to paste into your page head for AI identification.
